purpose: Test whether the market-independent Ability-derived coherent Wide Probability baseline remains stable across multiple racing eras without relying on 2025-2026 alone.

data.source: locally supplied TARGET-style high-class JRA flat history, 2016-2026
data.universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher, exactly three Top3 labels
data.leakage_rule: For test year Y, model coefficients are refit using years strictly earlier than Y only. Horse features use strictly prior high-class starts only.

ability_model_walkforward.architecture: Ability v1 predefined 14-feature L2 logistic regression
ability_model_walkforward.race_probability_projection: common logit shift so Top3 probabilities sum to exactly 3 per race

wide_probability.definition: For each 3-horse subset S, P(S) proportional to exp(sum(theta_i for i in S)); theta reproduces Ability Top3 marginals. Wide q_ij is the probability mass of all Top3 sets containing both i and j.

race_cluster_bootstrap.note: Negative favors coherent Wide Probability. Every individual yearly 95% interval was also below zero.

training_window_sensitivity.interpretation: Performance is nearly unchanged when old years are retained or discarded, reducing concern that one historical era dominates the result.

interpretation: The coherent Wide Probability transform is not a 2025-2026-only artifact: it improves pair LogLoss and Brier in every unseen test year from 2019 through 2026.
The gain is mainly probability coherence/calibration, not a dramatic new ranking edge; this is expected and desirable for an EV probability layer.
Results are stable across turf/dirt, distance bands, and class levels, including G1, but subgroup sizes differ and should not be used to create extra tuning rules yet.

The Ability architecture itself is temporally stable under expanding and rolling-window refits, though mean_class5 deserves monitoring because its coefficient sign is less stable than the other 13 features.
This validates Wide Probability as a long-term Shadow baseline, not as an automatic BUY rule. Profitability still requires separate decision-time wide-odds validation.

m3_policy.reason: The prior M3 residual candidate used 2024 for gamma selection and 2025-2026 for confirmation. That is useful but too short for the user's long-term stability standard.
m3_policy.required_test: Rebuild M3 walk-forward so each historical test year uses an M3 model fitted only on earlier years, then test one frozen residual-combiner rule across multiple untouched years.

production_policy.reason: Long-term probability stability is supported, but historical decision-time wide odds and prospective EV/ROI validation remain necessary before Production use.
